what_happened: Scene: layout/style 10 (grey cabinets, microwave column); knife (knife_6, black handle) in a drawer at the right end of the counter; the dark board is right behind the drawer (0.15 m from the knife) and the plate with a drumstick to its left. Stage 0, attempt 1: closed at 162 on the very end of the handle (wrist 152-200: handle runs diagonally, only its butt is between the finger pads), lifted 0.11 m, and at ~204 the fingers shut (0.003) and the knife slid out and fell back into the drawer (212-220). Attempt 2: same butt-end grasp at 677 (lift 0.145), slipped at 716; the knife landed standing on its spine/edge, blade up (wrist 744-772; packet tipped from 720). Close on air at 768. Attempt 3: closed on the upright blade at 1119 (lift 0.066), slipped at 1150. Attempt 4: grasped the upright knife at 1419 and lifted it 0.27 m, carried it held vertically (tip up) toward the board and released it at 1501 over the counter at the board's edge, 0.19 m from the board centre; the vertical knife toppled, fell 0.17 m and ended leaning blade-up against the open drawer front (left view 1504-1600). The arm then went to the plate and closed on the drumstick at 1582 (no lift) as time ran out.
causal_chain: butt-end grasp of the knife handle 162 -> knife slipped out at ~204 after a 0.11 m lift -> same slip at 677-716, knife ends standing on edge in the drawer -> grasps on the upright blade slip (1119-1150) -> 4th grasp 1419 lifts it but holds it vertical, released at the board edge 1501 (0.19 m from centre) -> knife toppled off the counter against the drawer -> stage 0 never held; timeout 1600
self_recovery: Four knife grasps (162, 677, 1119, 1419); the first three slipped, the fourth reached the board area but the release was off-target and the knife toppled off. Then moved on to the meat with stage 0 not done.
